item.title: North Schuylkill’s Luke Miller Signs to Continue Track and Field Career at Saint Joseph’s University
item.description: North Schuylkill senior Luke Miller officially took the next step in his academic and athletic journey, signing his National Letter of Intent to continue his education and compete in Track and Field at Saint Joseph's University. Miller, a member of the North Schuylkill Spartans track and field program, as well as the football team, was joined by family members, coaches, and school administrators for the signing ceremony, celebrating years of dedication and success at the high school level.
